prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Interactive Desktop Pet Behavior Sandbox: Redesign the waiting screen with an interactive desktop pet preview sandbox where users test actions and commands while pet generation finishes. (why: The waiting step has high latency (201s median / 2336s mean) and support emails report confusion on desktop controls after onboarding.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Shortcut Cheatsheet Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop controls cheatsheet screen right before final completion showcasing key combinations and desktop tray controls. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, leading to drop-offs at finish.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Multi-Angle Photo Preset Recommendation Flow: Introduce a multi-angle photo inspector step in upload_photos that gives immediate visual feedback on image lighting and framing quality. (why: 3 support emails cited custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion is low at 60.9%.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Initial Pet Selection: Reorder the sign_in step to occur right after initial pet picking so users anchor their selected pet to their account prior to upload. (why: 8 support emails mentioned missing or reset pets after signing back in, and securing the account right after pet pick prevents pet loss.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Recovery Banner: Add an explicit recovery hint banner on the sign-in screen clarifying that signing in restores existing desktop pets. (why: 8 support emails noted pets missing or reset after re-signing into existing accounts.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Choice Outcome Clarity Copy: Update path selection copy to clearly contrast creating a custom pet versus picking an instant companion. (why: Path selection takes high mean time (514s) with 76.2% conversion due to ambiguity over path outcomes.)
6: [home, notification] Background Generation Ready Desktop Toast: Enable desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet generation completes in the background. (why: Mean waiting time (2336s) indicates users minimize the desktop app during generation and lose track of progress.)
